decisions.reason: Despite earlier internal comparison with the withdrawn sister resin unit, this product still fits the firm's core injection and fluid-handling business closely enough that management would likely tolerate some uncertainty and keep it unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

The automatic airless spray gun is in a core application category, so even with weaker recent visibility management would be inclined to continue it while using existing sales and service channels rather than redeploy resources immediately.

A manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with the firm's established product logic, customer needs and distributor capabilities, which lowers the pressure to drop it unless performance is plainly unsatisfactory.
Because this is a multi-model product line in a central spray category, management is likely to view it as strategically important and adaptable enough to remain above the threshold for withdrawal.

The data logger is less central than the firm's main mechanical equipment lines, so if its market results remain uncertain or below aspiration after several years, a medium-sized German machinery firm would likely reallocate those resources to core products and new development.
